title: Swarm task state v2
description: Lean, machine-readable task state. Hard size budget: 4 KB. Narrative detail lives in .swarm/logs/<task>/, never here. Every maxLength below is a token-control mechanism, not a style preference.

schema_version.description: Reject any state file without this. v1 files (46 KB prose history) are not resumable; run swarm.ps1 migrate.

stage.description: One short line, e.g. 'Phase 7 of 9'. Not a sentence, not a paragraph.

head.description: HEAD sha at the last verified transition. Authoritative resume anchor.

plan_dir.description: Directory holding 00-plan.md and the phase files, e.g. .swarm/plans/<task>.

done.description: Completed work units. The only resume-critical array. Keep it complete; this replaces re-reading git log to reconstruct progress.

log.description: Path to the narrative log. Never read during resume.

remaining.description: Ordered work units still to do. This array IS the builder prompt. One line each.

phase_file.description: File the builder must read. This is how plan splitting pays off: only this file is read, not the whole plan.

gate.description: Exit gate, one line. Required before the unit can be marked done.

blockers.description: Open items. One line each with an owner. Replaces the 3.5 KB builder_run_findings block that duplicated history.

events.description: Append-only transition log. maxItems + maxLength are the hard budget. When full, fold the oldest events into a log file and keep the last 10. Detail longer than maxLength goes to a log file and is referenced by path.

detail.description: HARD CAP. One line. If you need more, write .swarm/logs/<task>/<n>-<stage>.md and put the path here.

decisions.description: Decisions the user made at HITL gates, with the reason. Stops plan revisions from growing the plan instead of the record growing here.

baseline.description: Measured ONCE. Re-measure only when a manifest/lockfile changes. Do not re-run a full build per phase.

manifest.description: Hash/short-id of the manifest the baseline was taken against.

ref.description: Where the full baseline lives, e.g. .swarm/logs/<task>/00-baseline.md

env.description: Environment facts discovered once (tool paths, flags, disk constraints). Resolved here instead of re-discovered and re-briefed every dispatch.

lock.description: Single-writer lease. Enforced by .swarm/locks/<task>.lock, mirrored here so a stale state file is still detectable.

holder.description: Session id, e.g. 'orch-<pid>-<epoch>'. Empty string means unheld.
